responses.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(replacement_cost) AS ratio, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film GROUP BY rating) SELECT rating, ratio, film_count, ratio - AVG(ratio) OVER () AS diff_from_avg FROM r ORDER BY rating

assumptions.assumption: The number of films is the count of all films in each rating (COUNT(*)), not only those with non-missing rental_rate or replacement_cost (both columns are NOT NULL anyway).
The 'plain average of the five rating-level values' is the unweighted mean of the five per-rating ratios, subtracted from each rating's ratio.

assumptions.assumption: The number of films is COUNT(*) of film rows per rating; the plain average is taken over the five rating-level ratios (unweighted by film count), as the request states.

assumptions.assumption: Number of films means COUNT(*) of films in each rating group (all films, including any with missing rental_rate or replacement_cost, though both columns are NOT NULL).
